# 📦 MENU - Advanced Server Menu Plugin  
**By PrabhatPie**

Bring your server to life with **MENU**, a powerful and lightweight plugin that adds a fully customizable GUI menu system for your players!

---

## ✨ Features
- 🧭 Easy-to-use **GUI-based server menu**
- ⚡ Execute commands with a simple click
- 🎨 Custom icons using any Minecraft material
- 🔒 Admin-only menu management
- 💾 Config-based storage (auto-load on restart)
- 🎵 Click sound effects for better interaction
- 🚫 Prevents item movement in GUI

---

## 🧑‍💻 Commands

### 🔧 Admin Commands
```
/menu create <name> <slots>
Creates a new menu (only one allowed)
Example: /menu create DOOM SMP MENU 27
```

```
/menu delete <name>
Deletes the existing menu
Example: /menu delete DOOM SMP MENU
```

```
/menu add <name> <slot> <material> <command>
Adds an item to the menu
Example: /menu add RTP 4 ENDER_PEARL rtp
```

```
/menu reload
Reloads the plugin configuration
```

---

### 👤 Player Command
```
/menu
Opens the server menu
```

---

## 🔐 Permissions
```
menu.admin   → Access to all admin commands
menu.use     → Allows players to open the menu
```

---

## ⚙️ How It Works
Admins can create a menu, add clickable items with commands, and players can open it using `/menu`. Each item executes a command when clicked, making navigation simple and interactive.

---
